ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Restrict_Renewal_Opportunities_Closed ) , ( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Renewal" ) , OR( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Won - Renewal" ) , ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Lost - Renewal" ) ) , NOT( ISCHANGED( StageName ) ) , NOT( ISCHANGED( Renewal_Status__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Renewal Opportunities cannot be edited when the Stage is Closed Won/Lost. Please reach out to Renewal Leadership to reopen.
